svg.title: The coral square at τ = i
svg.desc: Four-fold Gaussian-lattice symmetry makes weight 4 add and weight 6 cancel.
svg.text: The coral square at τ = i
One 90° rotation. Two radically different outcomes.
Gaussian lattice ℤ + iℤ, inside a finite square window
A quarter-turn permutes every finite square window.
